facts.activity_file: handing back a partially completed isolation

consequence.label: first aid or minor property damage

control_failures.control_label: mechanical support of a load during maintenance access
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

hazard_media: stored potential of an elevated component
facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: unplanned release of gravity energy at CV-3102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was first aid or minor property damage. The potential outcome was rated 2 against the site's consequence scale, above the 1 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control LOAD_SUPPORT_FOR_MAINTENANCE: the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed, and the accident investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the accident investigation classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access on CV-3102 and record the spot check before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in restoring plant to service, specifically handing back a partially completed isolation. CV-3102 (plant conveyors) is in service for coarse ore and reclaim conveying. The task proceeded during commissioning of replacement equipment while the mechanical support of a load during maintenance access had been bypassed. The gravity energy involved is held as suspended load, and the recorded presentation was fall, collapse, crush.
response.summary: On 1 May 2008 a near hit was recorded on CV-3102 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility during commissioning of replacement equipment; gravity energy held as suspended load was not released.
